run_filter_single_object_images: run the pascal_part_one_json module to filter annotations keeping only images with exactly one object
run_filter_base_classes_only: run the pascal_part_one_json module with --only_base to exclude novel classes bus and dog from the output
run_convert_voc_annotations: run the module to convert VOC XML annotations and PascalPart JSON into a filtered one-object JSON dataset
run_validate_image_object_count: run the module to validate image filenames against VOC XML object counts and filter to single-object images
run_generate_filtered_coco_format: run the module to generate a COCO-format JSON file containing only images with a single annotated object
